d: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her.  As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.
A mad scientist trying to cure polio must obtain human spinal fluid, and resorts to nefarious means by wearing an ape suit to procure victims for his experiment without being detected.

A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money.  The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.
One-of-a-kind alien invasion sci-fi featuring blood drinking alien clowns harvesting a small city.

In this classic adaptation of H.G. Wells' novel, a demented doctor (Burt Lancaster) spends years on a desolate tropical island working on a drug that will effectively alter animals into humans. Michael York and Barbara Carrera also star!

Vincent Price is a man haunted by his past. In this case, the past comes in the form of his now-deceased first wife Ligeia, who casts a shadow over an ill-advised second marriage, especially when Ligeia’s spirit returns in the form of a black cat.

A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him.  Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.
Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.
En butiksanställd upptäcker en mystisk växt med en blodtörstig aptit. Framgång följer, men priset visar sig vara människoliv, och situationen eskalerar.

A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead.  The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.
